verdict.rationale: Docs show Blueprints exposing "virtually the full range" of programmer concepts, and C++ gameplay classes integrate with the editor through the reflection system and Live Coding, with Visual Studio/Xcode as the toolchain. Community comments note Blueprints become inefficient at scale and push users to C++, which some find unproductive. Missing for 10: any documented script-level debugger (Blueprint breakpoints/stepping or a C++ debugging workflow), evidence that the full engine API is exposed rather than "virtually", and independent corroboration of productivity.
